data.body: [P2] Return serializable data from the S3 example. `GetObjectCommand` returns a response containing a live `Body` stream. The step immediately JSON-serializes that response, whose Node.js stream/socket references can be circular, causing serialization failure before checkpointing. The stream also cannot survive replay. Use a non-streaming command for this timeout example, or consume the body inside the step and return only serializable data, keeping cancellation active through the body read.
